text: Great! Follow steps submit pull request: “Fork” repository GitHub account. Clone “fork” local machine. Create new branch (git checkout -b feature/-feature-name). Make changes, ensure existing tests pass, adding new functionality, write tests . Make sure code follows package’s style (can use styler::style_pkg()). “Commit” changes (git commit -m "feat: description functionality"). Push branch “forked” repository (git push origin feature/-feature-name). Open “Pull Request” “fork” original rminka repository.

title: Get Direct Access to Minka Data
text: rminka toolkit interacting Minka API, providing consistent set functions help query retrieve biodiversity data. package’s functions grouped type data return: ) Project Queries: set complementary functions find projects associated observations. mnk_proj_byname(): Finds project’s ID using approximate project name. mnk_proj_info(): Retrieves detailed project information using known ID. mnk_proj_obs(): Fetches observations specific year within project. b) User Queries: Functions find users contributed observations. mnk_user_byname(): Finds user’s ID approximate login name. mnk_user_proj(): Find projects user explicitly subscribed based user_ID. mnk_user_obs(): Retrieves observations contributed user given year ( year specific month) id_user. c) Place Queries: Functions find places retrieve spatial data. mnk_places_byname(): Finds ID location using approximate place name. mnk_place_sf(): Returns sf geometry place, ready plotting packages like ggplot2 leaflet. d) Observation Queries: variety functions fetch observation data based different parameters. mnk_obs_id(): Retrieves single observation’s complete data using unique ID. mnk_obs(): Fetches observations based various parameters full year, specific month, single day. mnk_obs_bydays(): Retrieves observations within date range year. e) Auxiliary functions: set functions different utilities complement Minka’s observational data help processing used R packages (vegan, dismo, labdsv others). get_wrm_tax(): Retrieves complete taxonomy additional data (e.g., marine terrestrial ) WoRMS given scientific name. shrt_name(): Returns CEP name (abbreviated scientific name) separation point, given scientific name. functions designed used together. queries span multiple years, can easily loop years interest, run appropriate function, combine resulting tibbles dplyr::bind_rows().
